top_with_code.title: Jeveration: System One Models Now Generate

top_with_code.title: InclusionMed: Benchmarking AI for Inclusive Healthcare

top_with_code.title: AscendGYM: A Cost-Aware Kernel Optimization Benchmark for Real-World Workloads on Ascend NPUs

top_with_code.title: AllocFlow: End-to-End Portfolio Trading Action Generation from Raw Market Data
top_with_code.tldr: An end-to-end flow-matching framework generates joint portfolio allocations from raw multi-asset market histories via a cross-asset flow Transformer and a two-stage imitation and group-relative reinforcement learning procedure, improving risk-adjusted returns on cryptocurrency perpetual futures.

top_with_code.title: Weight-Space Programming Doesn't Need Transformers
top_with_code.tldr: When large language models write neural network weights without gradient-based training, they tend to design sparse table or associative-memory models that outperform same-sized Transformers with far fewer parameters and faster GPU inference, though pretrained LLMs remain more accurate.

top_with_code.tldr: A benchmark of realistic software engineering assignments reveals that current coding agents struggle to track requirements from clarification through implementation, verification, and handoff, completing few tasks despite partial test success.
